title: ProDER: A Continual Learning Approach for Fault Classification and Localization in Evolving Smart Grids
abstract: arXiv:2511.05420v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data-driven fault diagnosis models for smart grids are usually trained once on a fixed dataset, whereas in operation new fault types appear and monitoring is extended to new grid zones. Retraining from scratch on all accumulated data is costly, while naively updating the model on new data causes catastrophic forgetting. To address this problem, we formulate fault type classification and fault zone localization as continual learning (CL) problems and design four evaluation scenarios on the IEEE 13-node test feeder, three class-incremental and one domain-incremental. We then propose Prototype-based Dark Experience Replay (ProDER), which extends DER++ with prototype attraction and prototype-level repulsion losses that stabilize the feature space, temperature-scaled logit distillation, and a prototype-aware replay memory that retains both core and boundary samples of each class. translated_title: ProDER：一种面向不断演化的智能电网故障分类与定位的持续学习方法
translated_abstract: 面向智能电网的数据驱动故障诊断模型通常只在固定数据集上训练一次，而在实际运行中会出现新的故障类型，监测范围也会扩展到新的电网区域。在所有积累的数据上从头重新训练成本高昂，而直接在新数据上更新模型则会导致灾难性遗忘。为解决这一问题，我们将故障类型分类和故障区域定位构建为持续学习（CL）问题，并在IEEE 13节点测试馈线上设计了四种评估场景，其中三种为类增量场景，一种为域增量场景。随后，我们提出了基于原型的暗知识经验回放方法，该方法在DER++的基础上进行扩展，引入了稳定特征空间的原型吸引损失与原型级排斥损失、温度缩放的logit蒸馏，以及一种能够保留每个类别核心样本与边界样本的原型感知回放记忆库。在所测试的方法中，ProDER取得了最高的准确率。
tldr: 提出持续学习方法ProDER，通过原型吸引与排斥损失、温度缩放的logit蒸馏和原型感知回放记忆库，使智能电网故障分类与定位模型能够随新故障类型和新监测区域的出现持续学习，有效缓解灾难性遗忘并取得最高的分类准确率。
en_tdlr: ProDER, a continual learning method combining prototype attraction/repulsion losses, temperature-scaled logit distillation, and a prototype-aware replay memory, enables smart grid fault classification and localization models to incrementally adapt to new fault types and grid zones while mitigating catastrophic forgetting and achieving the highest accuracy.
